mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened recessionary expectations and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not negative when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%, or p-value >0.05 in t-test showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2% signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market confidence in economic expansion rises.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when GDPC1 crosses above 2%, or p-value >0.05 in t-test comparing returns to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 102 indicates weakening supply chains, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflationary pressures or production bottlenecks.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when INDPRO drops below 102, or p-value >0.05 in t-test showing no significant effect.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2%) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 1300) create synergistic demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic expansion accelerates.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST meet thresholds, or p-value >0.05 in multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 2%) alongside increasing unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signal conflicting policy signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market uncertainty rises.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when both triggers occur, or p-value >0.05 in interaction analysis.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rates exceeding 4.5% signal aggressive tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher inflation.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a monthly industrial production index below 102 triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to supply-side constraints exacerbating inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when INDPRO <102 in late-cycle periods, or p-value >0.05 in regime-specific analysis.
